name: Flexi Subscription for WooCommerce
author: flexiplugins

sections.description:
Flexi Subscription is a powerful WooCommerce Subscriptions plugin built to help store owners create, manage, and scale recurring payments, recurring billing, and subscription-based products with ease.

It enables businesses to launch subscription products, automate recurring billing workflows, and handle complete subscription management directly inside WooCommerce. Designed with a WooCommerce-native approach, the plugin integrates seamlessly into your existing store, allowing you to manage subscriptions without relying on complex third-party systems.

Whether you’re starting with your first WooCommerce subscription product or scaling a full recurring revenue business, Flexi Subscription gives you a stable, flexible, and future-ready foundation for subscription management and recurring payments.

With Flexi Subscription for WooCommerce, You Can:

  • Create and sell WooCommerce subscriptions and recurring products
  • Automate recurring billing and recurring payments
  • Manage complete subscription management workflows (renewals, status, lifecycle)
  • Display clear subscription details during Cart and Checkout
  • Show a clean Subscription Summary to improve conversions
  • Build scalable, WooCommerce-native subscription systems

Free Version Features

  • Create WooCommerce subscription products (simple products)
  • Configure recurring billing intervals and billing periods
  • Manage subscription renewals and recurring payments
  • Handle full subscription lifecycle management
  • Customize subscription pricing display for better clarity
  • Fully compatible with WooCommerce Blocks checkout
  • Lightweight, fast, and built for subscription scalability

Pro Version Features (Upcoming)

The Pro version expands your WooCommerce subscriptions capabilities with advanced recurring billing and subscription management tools:

  • Support for variable subscription products and variations
  • Configure subscription settings at the variation level
  • Add signup fees, free trials, and billing synchronization
  • Advanced recurring payment scheduling and control
  • Separate delivery schedules from billing cycles
  • Flexible delivery intervals and synchronization rules
  • Developer-friendly APIs, hooks, and filters
  • Built for high-performance subscription businesses

Why Choose Flexi Subscription?

Flexi Subscription is ideal for WooCommerce store owners who want a lightweight yet powerful WooCommerce subscriptions plugin to manage recurring payments, streamline subscription management, and grow predictable recurring revenue.

It starts simple but scales with your business, making it perfect for:

  • Subscription boxes
  • Membership sites
  • SaaS products
  • Service-based recurring billing models
sections.installation:
1. Upload the flexi-subscription folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Add subscription product from woocommerce product screen.
